entities.name: Identity Request procedure
entities.description: Procedure used to request a UE to provide specific identification parameters such as SUCI, IMEI, IMEISV, EUI-64, or MAC address.

entities.name: SUCI
entities.description: Subscription Concealed Identifier, a privacy preserving identifier containing the concealed SUPI.

entities.name: IMEI
entities.description: International Mobile Equipment Identity, a format of PEI used for equipment identification.

entities.name: IMEISV
entities.description: International Mobile Equipment Identity and Software Version number, a format of PEI.

entities.name: EUI-64
entities.description: Extended Unique Identifier 64-bit, a format of PEI.

entities.name: MAC address
entities.description: Media Access Control address, a format of PEI.

entities.name: PEI formats
entities.description: IMEI, IMEISV, EUI-64, and MAC address are formats of PEI (Permanent Equipment Identifier).

relations.description: Identity Request procedure can request the SUCI identification parameter.
Identity Request procedure can request the IMEI identification parameter.
Identity Request procedure can request the IMEISV identification parameter.
Identity Request procedure can request the EUI-64 identification parameter.
Identity Request procedure can request the MAC address identification parameter.
IMEI is defined as a format of PEI.
IMEISV is defined as a format of PEI.

MAC address is defined as a format of PEI.
